title: Retry locked progress saves
summary: Progress JSON saves now retry the final atomic replace when a short-lived reader lock blocks pipeline_progress.json.
reason: The WebView diagnostics/log polling path can briefly hold pipeline_progress.json open while FFmpeg progress writes try to replace it. On Windows this raises a sharing violation and produced repeated 'Failed to save progress' warnings during active encodes.
behavior_before: A transient reader lock on pipeline_progress.json caused Save-Progress to immediately fail, mark progress persistence unhealthy, and log 'Failed to save progress' even though the file became writable moments later.
behavior_after: Save-Progress keeps the atomic File.Replace/Move behavior but retries briefly before reporting failure, so normal WebView polling no longer turns short reader contention into progress-save warnings.
tests_added: Invoke-ProgressStateTelemetryChecks.ps1 covers Save-Progress retrying through a temporary reader lock.
manual_validation: PASS: reproduced pre-fix Save-Progress failure with a temporary reader lock: File.Replace reported 'The process cannot access the file because it is being used by another process.'
